description.p: A modern, feature-rich task management application built with Python and GTK 4, designed for productivity and ease of use, designed following GNOME Human Interface Guidelines.
Alignment with the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines and libadwaita.

ul.li: The Edit Project dialog crashed on open
Icon names missing from the Flatpak runtime rendered as broken images
Day counts in date headings were never translated
Typing in the task list stole keystrokes from the new task entry
Custom styling made the window unreadable in the dark colour scheme
Replaced dialogs deprecated in GTK 4.10 and libadwaita 1.6
The task details panel is now an adaptive overlay split view
Deleting a project asks for confirmation; deleting a task can be undone
Added empty state placeholders, toasts and a keyboard shortcuts window
The dark theme switch is now a Follow System / Light / Dark choice
File import and export go through the desktop portal, so the app no longer needs broad filesystem permissions

description.p: Maintenance release with minor improvements and fixes
Refactor the codebase into smaller UI modules, add import/export and search improvements, and introduce task subtasks.
Fix sorting, date handling, and atomic save logic
